jobs.title: Program Manager, People Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented, highly organized program manager to run the day-to-day internal operations for Uber’s People team. Reporting to the Director of People Strategy & Planning, you will be the operational backbone of the HR organization—managing headcount tracking, budget coordination, vendor workflows, and project portfolios. Working closely with Finance, Talent Acquisition, and People team leaders, you will ensure our internal planning cycles and processes run smoothly, accurately, and on schedule.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* **Budget & Headcount Coordination:** Partner with Finance and S&P leadership to coordinate annual and quarterly budget planning. Distribute templates, track departmental inputs, and ensure all People team leaders submit their budget and headcount requests accurately and on time.
* **In-Cycle Roster Management:** Maintain day-to-day visibility into the People team’s headcount. Track open requisitions, internal transfers, backfills, and reporting-line changes—partnering closely with Talent Acquisition to ensure the HR org chart and headcount rosters are always accurate.
* **Vendor & PO Management:** Develop a People-wide framework and operating plan for managing ongoing Purchase Order (PO) tracking, invoice approvals, and contract renewals, ensuring the People team’s spending is organized and complies with procurement rules. Partner across teams within the People Team managing vendors and POs.
* **S&P Portfolio Tracking:** Maintain the master project tracker for the Strategy & Planning team. Route incoming requests, track milestones across different team members, and flag operational bottlenecks so leadership has a clear view of all ongoing work.
* **Operational Reporting:** Build and maintain clean, reliable spreadsheets and dashboards for headcount status, POs, and project updates, ensuring data hygiene and providing leadership with an accurate, real-time view of HR operations.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 5+ years of experience in HR operations, business operations, program coordination, or departmental budget/headcount tracking.
* Bachelor’s Degree
* Proven track record of managing complex operational spreadsheets, coordinating annual planning inputs, and maintaining high data accuracy across multiple teams.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Hands-on experience managing departmental headcount rosters, tracking open job requisitions, coordinating budget intake, or administering Purchase Orders (POs) alongside Finance/FP&A.
* High proficiency in spreadsheets (Google Sheets/Excel) and familiarity with enterprise HR, procurement, and project tracking systems.
* Strong organizational discipline and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple recurring operational cycles (e.g., monthly close, quarterly planning) at the same time.
* A collaborative, service-oriented mindset, with the ability to work smoothly alongside senior HR leaders, Finance partners, and COE leads in a fast-paced environment.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $142,000 per year - USD $158,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $142,000 per year - USD $158,000 per year.  
  
For Washington, DC-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $142,000 per year - USD $158,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Farmers’ Market Access & Equity Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Department: FoodFarming**

**Classification: Coordinator II**

**Reports to: Program Manager**

**Location: Berkeley CA/Hybrid**

**Job Type: Full-Time; Non-Exempt, Hourly**

**Union Status: This is a Union position**

**Ecology Center Background:**

The Ecology Center's mission is to inspire and build a sustainable, healthy, and just future for the East Bay, California, and beyond. Since 1970, we've transformed sustainability ideas into everyday practice, offering actionable information, reliable infrastructure, and leadership for lasting change. We operate the nation's first curbside recycling service, nationally recognized food and farming programs, and model education, engagement, and youth development activities.

**Role Overview:**

The Farmers' Market Access and Equity Program Coordinator works under the direction of the Farmers' Market AccessEquity Program Manager, in coordination with the Food and Farming Program Director, to assist with all aspects relating to the Ecology Center's work promoting healthy food access at California farmers' markets. The Farmers' Markets Access and Equity Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize Federal Assistance Benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved populations and drive additional customers/income to small and mid-sized family farmers.

The Ecology Center is actively working to create and promote an alternative food system that is based on the values of environmental protection, justice, and access to healthy, sustainably produced food for all. The Farmers' Markets AccessEquity Program (FMAE) seeks to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved Californians while also supporting small and mid-sized family farms. The FMAE Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize SNAP benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets. The FMAE Program Coordinator performs job duties in support of the Ecology Center's work supporting healthy food access at California farmers' markets, including the Market Match Program, Farmers' Market EBT/SNAP access programming , and the FMFinder.org tool. This is a hybrid position that requires employees to work onsite at least 2 days per week. The position is covered under the Ecology Center/IWW Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), and employees are required to maintain union membership once they complete their probation period.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist Program Manager in developing Program work-plan, goals, and objectives in accordance with grant objectives and the Ecology Center mission and strategic plan.
* Assist Program Manager in executing work-plan, goals, and objectives associated with the statewide Market Match Program, the Farmers' Market EBT/SNAP access programming, CA Alliance of Farmers Markets, and the Farmers' Market Finder tool.
* Provide support and technical assistance to Market Match partners, including but not limited to training on reporting and invoicing procedures and other program requirements
* Prepare contracts for distribution to sub awardees, and coordinate the contracting process, including follow-up with sub awardees to verify contract details, signatures, final review and approval of contracts.
* Coordinate monthly sub awardee invoice processing and reporting materials review, including verification of all expenses and backup documentation, and follow-up with sub awardees as needed.
* Assist in curating and updating the Program's outreach, promotional, and training tools including the production and distribution of the Program's electronic newsletter, the Market Match website, the Farmers' Market Finder website, the program's Facebook page and other social networking tools.
* Assist with facilitating bi-monthly webinars, phone calls, the annual Market Match conference, and other meetings.
* Educate, recruit, and inform farmers' market managers, associations, and partner organizations interested in CalFresh EBT access at farmers' markets and Market Match incentives, through the development and distribution of Program communications, including informational materials and e-newsletters.
* Periodically coordinate regional outreach campaign logistics including direct mailers, text message, and other forms of outreach, aimed at recruiting new customers to farmers' markets.
* Perform site-visits with Market Match partners throughout the state to ensure program and grant compliance.
* Input and maintain data in order to feed statewide databases, fundraise, and report for grants.
* Customize promotional, outreach, and educational collateral.
* Provide technical assistance to farmers' market managers and associations that wish to establish, implement, and promote their market's CalFresh EBT program. This includes, but is not limited to: assistance with FNS application, acquiring Point Of Sale (POS) equipment, EBT scrip design and ordering, planning for market staffing issues, record-keeping and vendor education.
* Conduct follow up activities to track and report progress in establishing and implementing EBT programs.
* Field initial phone calls and emails regarding Market Match, Farmers' Market EBT, Farmers' Market Finder, answer questions, and direct parties to appropriate resources or individuals.
* Meet with the Program Manager and FMAE team once per week or as needed.
* Observe safe operating practices and comply with organizational safety policies.
* Maintain familiarity with, follow, and ensure staff compliance with all Ecology Center policies and procedures in the performance of daily duties.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Implementation Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Hively’s mission is to build meaningful connections with families and communities, ensuring access to resources every child in Alameda County needs to thrive. Our vision is to transform the lives of children and families to benefit all communities and ensure a promising future for generations to come. We believe that through subsidized child care, mental health support, and community services centered in families of all types and backgrounds, we can profoundly impact the communities we serve. If this resonates with you, we invite you to apply to join our team.

**Our Team & Culture**

Our Team at Hively is a passionate and diverse group of individuals from a wide range of different lived experiences, backgrounds and professional expertise. We strive every day to create an environment for families and staff that is inclusive and welcoming of different experiences and perspectives. We prioritize learning, listening, and growing together and to foster a culture of respect.

**The Opportunity**

The Implementation Program Manager will serve as a key member of the Hively launch team in the administration of the Measure C Subsidized Child Care and Minimum Wage Floor and Operating Grants program, funded and overseen by First 5 Alameda County.

With an annual budget of $85 million, this exciting program is designed to stabilize and strengthen Alameda County’s child care provider landscape through two related arms: (1) distribution and filling of subsidized child care slots (Contracted Slots) and (2) implementation of a minimum wage floor and operating grants (Operating Grants). The first arm expands access to high-quality, subsidized child care by funding openings for an estimated 1,400 children, from birth to age five, across Alameda County. The second arm establishes a $25/hour minimum wage floor for eligible child care providers and offers operating grants to support program participation.

Working closely with the VP of New Ventures and program Directors, the Implementation Manager will help turn the initiative’s vision, policies, and requirements into the systems, processes, and day-to-day operations needed to successfully launch and manage a large-scale public program. The Manager will take ownership of major operational workstreams, help solve problems as they arise, and ensure that important details do not get lost as the program moves from planning and development into testing, piloting, and full-scale operations.

The position will focus primarily on the subsidized child care slot arm, while working closely with the Operating Grants, Technology, Communications, and Finance teams, particularly during the initial program launch. Given the newness of the program, this Manager may be called on to serve as a generalist, capable of floating between teams to fill emerging needs. As the program matures, the Manager may help build and lead a team and manage day-to-day operations in a specialized area, including the subsidized child care slot arm, RBA management, or an alternative complementary role.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful, hands-on manager who is comfortable taking on a wide range of responsibilities in a fast-moving environment. They can move easily between big-picture planning and detailed execution, take initiative without waiting for direction, and bring structure to ambiguous, complex or changing situations. They are equally comfortable developing a program-wide process, writing a step-by-step staff guide, troubleshooting a technology or provider payment issue, or helping a new team member understand their responsibilities. They are motivated to learn on the fly, and inspired to be on the ground floor of a transformational initiative.

### **What you will do:**

**Program Leadership & Implementation**

* Serve as a senior operational partner, helping lead the planning, launch, and ongoing implementation of the program.
* Take ownership of major operational workstreams, translating program policies and funding requirements into day-to-day systems and procedures.
* Lead the development and implementation of core program operations, including application intake and review, determining provider and family eligibility, payment processes, reporting, compliance, audits and recertification.
* Work across teams to connect the many moving parts, including technology, finance, provider communications, technical assistance, training, data, and reporting.
* Act as a programmatic liaison for the Coordinated Eligibility and Enrollment (CEE) integration, aligning subsidized child care slot implementation procedures with emerging technology requirements.
* Identify problems, make recommendations, and take action to keep implementation on track. Escalate significant issues to program leadership with proposed solutions.
* Step in wherever needed to address immediate program needs, particularly during the start-up phase (anticipated to last approximately six months).

**Program Documentation and Deliverables**

* Lead the development of clear and comprehensive program procedures, staff manuals, provider guidelines, user guides, toolkits, and training materials.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation as policies, systems, and program requirements change.
* Author major components of deliverables, including implementation procedures and operational reports.
* Collaborate with the Technology team to ensure seamless record-level data integration, automated reporting, status dashboards, and disaggregated metrics (e.g., geography, demographics, provider types) to assess equity and performance.
* Support required program reporting and performance tracking, including Results-Based Accountability (RBA) measures.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor program operations and performance to identify issues, delays, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead efforts to improve workflows, technology, provider support, and internal processes throughout program phases.

jobs.description:
### **Application Window**

**Open date:** November 24, 2026

**Next review date:** Wednesday, Dec 9, 2026 at 11:59pm (Pacific Time)
  
Apply by this date to ensure full consideration by the committee.

**Final date:** Wednesday, May 24, 2028 at 11:59pm (Pacific Time)
  
Applications will continue to be accepted until this date, but those received after the review date will only be considered if the position has not yet been filled.

### **Position description**

Professional Researcher
  
Family and Community Medicine
  
University of California, San Francisco

Position Start Date: January 1, 2027 or as negotiated.

The Person-Centered Reproductive Health Program within the UCSF Department of Family & Community Medicine announces a search for a Professional Researcher, a non-faculty academic position. Appointment will be at the Assistant rank. This position is based in San Francisco, CA, and is a full-time position (with some protected time for independent research); the initial appointment will be for two years.

The Assistant Professional Researcher will assist the Principal Investigators, Dr. Christine Dehlendorf, Professor, and Dr. Rachel Logan, Assistant Professor, in the Department of Family and Community Medicine, on a number of studies focused on person-centered contraceptive care including the Postpartum Contraception NIH Grant, the INTERACT project, and a series of projects exploring how best to offer HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis to cisgender women and service users in reproductive health and primary care settings.

The successful candidate should have a strong background in qualitative and mixed methods research to help lead the formative research component of this research program. Working in close collaboration with the study Principal Investigators, candidate will develop qualitative and qualitative survey instruments, perform quantitative and qualitative data analysis, facilitate community and stakeholder engagement, and contribute to manuscript drafting and editing. In addition, and with guidance from the Project Director, they will oversee the administration of the projects, including data management and compliance with research regulations (such as human subjects protection).

The successful applicant will have the opportunity to contribute substantively to the intellectual work of the studies, participating fully in study design, oversight of data collection, analysis, and research publications. Experience with qualitative survey instruments, in-depth interviews, focus groups, and phenomenology and quantitative research is required.

In collaboration with study PIs, the fellow may also propose supplemental research questions or activities that may contribute to their own research agenda, subject to feasibility. Opportunities to further pursue independent research (e.g., through collaboration on other research projects and/or other PIs, grant writing, skills building workshops or trainings) is also encouraged and can be negotiated on an individual basis.

Responsibilities include:
  

* Design and manage qualitative and quantitative data collection approaches and analyses, in-depth interviews and focus groups, and survey administration.
* Participate in and co-lead data analysis, report writing, and research publications.
* Oversee compliance with research regulations (such as human subjects protection).
* Present research findings at meetings, seminars, and conferences.

  

* Organize and co-lead study team meetings.
* Carry out independent and/or collaborative research.

Qualifications include:
  

* Ph.D. or equivalent in a social science discipline (e.g., sociology, social work, etc.) or in public health, with training in qualitative and quantitative research methods.
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies such as in-depth interviewing and mixed methods approaches.
* Experience with survey design and administration and quantitative data analysis
* Ability to collaborate across disciplines and institutions, while working independently.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, including in one-on-one interactions as well as in groups.
* Excellent organizational and managerial skills.
* Experience with federally funded research and/or with mixed methods projects, and with project management, is preferred.

To Apply:
  
Interested applicants should submit the following materials:
  

* Cover letter that includes: qualifications based on the position details above; description of prior research experience including methods used; dates of availability; and names and contact information for at least three references.
* Current CV
* Writing sample

The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. Our work combines process design, systems thinking, and operational change to turn fragmented workflows into reliable, repeatable, and well-controlled operations.

jobs.title: Customer Support Representative
jobs.description:
### **In Some Jobs You Take Orders. In This One, You Write History.**

Join the healthcare information technology team that’s turning drug and medical device data into knowledge used by thousands of hospitals, the majority of U.S. health plans, retail pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers, and millions of health care decision-makers throughout the world. Partnering with our information system developer and healthcare institution customers, you’ll help evolve leading-edge thinking into reality and make a measurable difference in improving human health.

We’re looking for people who are intelligent, productive, committed, willing and able to go above and beyond, passionate about making a difference, innovative and energized. You’ll play an essential role in a successful company’s continued growth.

**Are you ready for this exciting challenge?**

First Databank (FDB) is currently seeking a Customer Support Representative. This is the first human point of contact for FDB customers. You resolve customer questions, own customer outcomes from start to finish, and help the team adopt AI-assisted support tools as they’re introduced. As AI takes on more routine work over time, the role will shift toward judgment, checking AI output for quality, reaching out to customers before they ask, and spotting customers at risk of leaving.

This position is based out of our San Francisco, CA office and follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation to work onsite at least three days per week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Resolve customer questions and common product problems across support channels as the first point of contact.
* Act as the customer’s contact for cases that need FDB’s expert teams. This includes taking in the request, routing it, explaining the expert’s answer to the customer and seeing the case through to closure.
* Follow up on cases waiting for resolution. Use available tracking tools and automation as they’re introduced.
* Spot frustrated or at-risk customers and flag them for follow-up.
* Escalate technical or complex issues to Technical Support with complete case notes.
* Use AI-assisted tools (drafting, summarizing, knowledge search) where available. Check and personalize all AI-generated content before it reaches customers and make sure any answer involving drug or clinical information gets qualified human review.
* Take part in AI pilots: test the tools, give feedback, and report wrong or missing answers to the Team Lead and AI Knowledge Owner.
* Check in with customers proactively, support onboarding, and follow up with dissatisfied customers.
* Write and update help articles so customers can answer routine questions themselves.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

* Cases resolved per week.
* First-contact resolution rate and median time to resolution.
* CSAT maintained or improved; reopened-case rate flat or declining.
* Adoption of AI tools and quality of feedback during the rollout.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Customer support experience in software, healthcare IT or a related field. Familiarity with drug databases or clinical content is a plus.
* Strong writing and judgment.
* Openness to using AI tools and willingness to help shape how the team uses them.
* Demonstrated empathy and de-escalation skills, and the ability to spot signs a customer may leave.

**Accommodations**
------------------

We are committed to an accessible application process. If you need an accommodation to apply, please contact accommodations@fdbhealth.com . This email address is for accommodation requests only.

**Benefits**
------------

This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; a flexible spending account; paid holidays; paid time off; an employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

**Compensation**

Base Salary Range:

$58,000 — $72,000 USD

**Job Summary**: The Case Manager – FCS Specialist, under direct supervision of the Program Manager, or their designee, will be responsible to provide comprehensive intervention and referral services to families who are involved with Child Protective Services (CPS) or families who have been referred to the Human Service Agency’s (HSA) Family and Children’s Services (FCS) Hotline.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**:

* Provide comprehensive services to families experiencing domestic/intimate partner violence, including crisis intervention, safety planning, counseling, case management, home visits, self-sufficiency skill building, and parenting education.
* Conduct individualized risk/lethality assessments.
* Organize and conduct skill building and peer support engagement opportunities to provide general education for clients on domestic/intimate partner violence, positive parenting techniques, understanding the impact of DV on children, building resiliency in children, and related topics.
* Manage client referrals to needed community resources external to and within La Casa's continuum of program services.
* Provide consultation and referral services to the person who perpetrated domestic/intimate partner violence, as appropriate.
* Participate in child, family team meetings and/or case consultation with FSA’s assigned Protective Service Worker (PSW).
* Conduct individual and program consultation to FCS regarding issues related to domestic violence, on a regular and as-needed basis.
* Conduct presentations to FCS staff and the client population related to the services that La Casa will provide.
* Maintain an ongoing knowledge of FCS practices and policies such as the California Child Welfare Core Practice Model.
* Strictly maintain for safekeeping client files and confidential client communications in compliance with grant and/or contract guidelines.
* Execute, maintain, and submit program documentation and data, including evaluations and surveys, in accordance with grant requirements.
* Other duties to specific needs and operations at (DIC) drop-in center for support, as directed.

**Minimum Requirements**:

* BA/BS in Behavioral Sciences (Social Work preferred) and a minimum of 5 years of verifiable case management experience in a relevant and related field, preferred. Or GED/High School diploma or 2-year degree with a minimum of 7 years, verifiable, case management experience in domestic violence, child welfare, housing and homelessness, mental health, substance abuse, and physical illnesses.
* Significant experience providing comprehensive domestic violence intervention and consultation services for families who are involved with or referred to Child Protective Services (CPS).
* Direct experience working collaboratively with public agencies, such as child welfare or other community-based organizations that provide services to the targeted population.
* Strong working knowledge of community resources in the San Francisco-Bay Area.
* Knowledge of counseling techniques, peer counseling models, crisis intervention, social milieu, and group facilitation.
* Understanding of confidentiality and privilege laws.
* Ability to work independently and navigate public transportation to and from a multi-site collaborative.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work as a team member with a strong commitment to collaborative work.
* Ability to approach work with a positive, supportive, and sensitive attitude and demeanor.
* Ability to respond sensitively to women, teens, and their children who may be in crisis and/or seeking support.
* Must be able to fulfill physical requirements of the job (lifting, pushing, pulling, carrying, walking up and down stairs multiple times per day, etc.).
* Understanding of confidentiality and privilege laws governing domestic violence work.
* Verifiable completion of state-mandated 40-hour domestic violence counselor training. Or will be completed during the next scheduled agency 40-hour domestic violence counselor training, including working one overnight shift at La Casa’s emergency shelter.
* Clearance through DOJ Live Scan fingerprinting is required. La Casa de las Madres will consider applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance.
* Valid CA driver's license may be required (depending on the position), clean driving record, and insurable under agency policy.
* TB (Tuberculosis) clearance
* **Bilingual preferred: English/Spanish**

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation
* Company-sponsored 403(b) retirement plan
* Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans
* Company-sponsored life and long-term disability insurance
* Generous paid time off, including 13 paid holidays, birthdays, and work anniversaries.

  
Monday - Friday, 8:30 a.m. - 5 p.m. May be required to work weekends and holidays  
Full-Time 40 hours non-exempt

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
**avfleet.ai** is a FaaS company that operates large scale depots that manage EV and AV fleets. In the Operations Supervisor role, you will lead our Operations Coordinator team and their driver cohorts. You will own the schedule, and be accountable for driver KPIs. If you like solving staffing problems in real time and are passionate about supervising high performing teams then this job is for you.  
  
**What you’ll do**

* Lead the coordinator team. Direct a team of Operations Coordinators who together supervise about 80 drivers — set priorities, resolve escalations, and hold the team accountable for their driver groups.
* Own the schedule. Build driver and Operations Coordinator shift schedules against forecasted volume, manage call-outs, and keep overtime under control.
* Develop people. Coach drivers and coordinators, run performance conversations, handle corrective action and nurture a culture of ownership, collaboration and sense of urgency.
* Keep timekeeping clean. Review and approve driver and coordinator hours, confirm meal and rest periods are recorded correctly, and ensure strict compliance with California wage and hour laws.
* Run the daily numbers. Track attendance, driver KPIs, and exceptions, and propose action plans for improving performance. Own the outcome when things go sideways. Direct the response to on-site incidents and vehicle events, figure out what changed, and make sure it gets reported and fixed.

**What you bring**

* Two or more years supervising or leading an hourly workforce in delivery, logistics, transportation, warehouse, or field operations — or an equivalent combination of experience and training
* Experience building schedules and managing timekeeping for 20 or more hourly employees
* Comfort with scheduling, timekeeping, and dispatch software, and with spreadsheets
* Availability for early morning, evening, and weekend shifts on a rotating basis
* Clear communication — you can coach someone and document it.
* A valid driver’s license, and the ability to meet our vehicle insurability standards and the driving-eligibility requirements of the delivery platforms we operate on. Operating our vehicles is an occasional part of this job, and no other form of transportation substitutes for moving a company van.

**We don’t require a degree for this role.**  
  
**Nice to have**

* Prior experience driving on a rideshare or delivery platform such as Uber or Lyft.
* Experience with EV fleets, charging operations, or other fleet depot operations.
* Working knowledge of California labor laws pertaining to overtime and meal and rest breaks.
* Conversational ability in Spanish.

**The work environment**  
This is an on-site role in an active vehicle yard. You’ll move between the office and the yard throughout the day, occasionally lift items up to 40 pounds, occasionally get in and out of vehicles, and work a schedule that includes early mornings, evenings, and weekends. If you need reasonable accommodation to perform any part of this job, we’ll work through it with you.  
  
**Compensation and benefits**  
Base salary: $72,050 – $75,000 per year. This is the good-faith range we reasonably expect to pay for this position on hire. Where you land in the range depends on your experience, skills, and internal equity.  
We also offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and California paid sick leave.

Email your resume and the role you’re applying for to hiring@avfleet.ai  
We read every application — no automated screening, no resume-ranking software. A person reviews your materials.

jobs.title: Teleoperations Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Mind**
--------------

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------

Teleoperations is how Mind collects its own robot training data. Our robot operators drive Mind's robots through real manufacturing tasks, producing the demonstration data our robot foundation models learn from. The Teleoperations Operations team runs the rapidly growing team.

As Teleoperations Operations Lead, you will own the collection floor end to end and report directly to Daniel Burrows, Head of Data. You will turn collection programs into a reliable, high-quality flow of training data: hiring and scheduling the team, running both shifts, keeping robots and stations up, and holding the floor to clear throughput and quality targets. You will also write the operating playbook we use to open new collection sites. This is a chance to build and scale the operation that feeds Mind's models, at the point where research meets the physical world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Run daily collection operations.** Own the teleoperation floor across the day and swing shifts: shift plans, station assignments, task queues and hand-offs, so every station is collecting usable data during every scheduled hour.
* **Hit throughput and quality targets.** Set and track operating metrics such as usable hours of data per shift, station utilization, episode success rate and rejection rate. Diagnose drops and fix them with changes to process, staffing or tooling.
* **Build and lead the team.** Hire, onboard and manage staff robot operators, core data collectors, shift leads, a people operations lead and a prop master. Grow the team with clear levels, career paths and performance management.
* **Train and certify operators.** Design training and certification for new robots, tasks and control interfaces, and run regular calibration sessions so operators produce consistent, high-quality demonstrations.
* **Turn collection programs into execution.** Partner with the Teleoperations Program team and our researchers to translate data requests (task, environment, embodiment, volume and deadline) into floor layouts, scene and prop setups, and schedules, and give early feedback on feasibility and cost.
* **Own data quality at the source.** Work with our Annotation & Labelling and Data Quality teams to define episode acceptance criteria, run QA and spot checks on the floor, and close the loop on issues found downstream.
* **Keep robots and stations running.** Work with hardware, robotics and data infrastructure engineers on uptime: triage robot, rig and software failures, manage spares and preventive maintenance, and track downtime and its root causes.
* **Own safety on the floor.** Run the safety program for the collection floor, including robot safety procedures, incident reporting and operator ergonomics, and keep the site compliant as it grows.
* **Plan capacity.** Model headcount, shift coverage and station capacity against the data plan, and run a weekly operating review and a quarterly capacity plan.
* **Scale to new sites.** Write the operating playbook (staffing model, training, QA and tooling) and help stand up additional collection sites as the program grows.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in operations, including 4+ years leading multi-shift teams of 20 or more people, with shift leads or managers reporting to you.
* Experience running hands-on operations in robotics, autonomous vehicles, hardware, manufacturing, or ML data collection or labeling (for example AV test fleets, robot data collection, or warehouse automation).
* Track record of setting and hitting throughput, quality and uptime targets, and of using SQL, spreadsheets or dashboards to analyze operating data yourself.
* Experience designing training and certification programs for a skilled technical workforce.
* Working knowledge of robot and machinery safety practices (for example ISO 10218, ANSI/RIA R15.06 and lockout/tagout) and experience running a site safety program.
* Experience hiring quickly and building processes from scratch in a fast-growing company.
* Clear written and verbal communication with operators, engineers, researchers and executives.

**Who we are**

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We're changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don't just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

As the Operations Coordinator, you are an integrity driven person at the center of the day-to-day operations and activities at the Bayview Child Development Center. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and enjoys delivering great customer service in an educational setting. You have a passion for developing efficient systems to support operations and take pride in maintaining a welcoming, organized and safe environment. Be the administrative and HR backbone for a kind, compassionate and fun team that teaches yoga and cooking to children ages 5–12, in our after-school program and summer camps.

As our HR & Administrative Coordinator, you'll work closely with our director to keep our team staffed, trained and supported, and to keep our programs running smoothly. You're based on site at our after-school program, and most of your shift is focused HR and admin work. You'll use AI tools (we use Claude) every day to draft emails, update documents and keep systems organized. You don't need to be an expert, just curious and willing to learn.

* Conduct new-hire onboarding, including new-staff orientation and training
* Ensure completion of all employment documentation, including I-9s and new-hire paperwork

**Administrative**

* Billing and registration for all programs in our registration software
* Summer camp coordination: registration, staffing, supplies and parent communication
* Weekly newsletter, plus Canva and Squarespace website updates
* Monitoring and ordering supplies (first aid, arts and crafts, office, culinary staples), and working with vendors on quotes, ordering, billing and delivery
* Prompt, professional and thoughtful communication with families, staff and partners

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of experience in HR, office administration, a school office, an after-school program, a summer camp or something similar
* Experience interviewing candidates and making hiring recommendations (preferred)
* Experience with kids ages 5–11 and comfort setting calm, clear limits
* Warm, professional communication with parents and staff, including the hard conversations
* Discretion with confidential staff and family information
* Strong skills in Google Docs, Google Sheets, Canva and Squarespace;
* Comfortable using AI tools for everyday work, or excited to learn

* A love for cooking, yoga and mindfulness
* Reliable transportation

jobs.description:
**Why choose us?**

Albertsons Companies is at the forefront of the revolution in retail. With a fixation on raising the bar with innovation and building belonging through our culture, our team is rallying our company around a unique purpose***: to create joy around each table and inspire a healthier tomorrow for every community.***

Albertsons Companies is one of the largest food and drug retailers in the United States, with over 2,200 stores in 34 states and the District of Columbia. Our well-known banners include Albertsons, Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco, Shaw's, Acme, Tom Thumb, Randalls, United Supermarkets, Pavilions, Star Market, Haggen, Carr’s, Kings Food Markets, and Balducci's Food Lovers Market. We support our stores with 22 distribution centers and 19 manufacturing plants.

  

**Bring your flavor**

Building the future of food and well-being starts with you. Join our team and bring your best self to the table.

Are you ready to lead a team in a fast-paced production environment? Join us as a Production Supervisor and be a key contributor to our production success. If you excel at motivating teams, managing production lines, and maintaining quality standards, we encourage you to apply.

**What you will be doing**

The Quality Assurance (QA) Manager serves as the site leader for Food Safety, Quality, and Regulatory Compliance at our beverage manufacturing facility. This role is accountable for protecting consumers, safeguarding beverage quality and shelf life, ensuring brand integrity, and enabling business growth.

The QA Manager leads and continuously improves the site’s Food Safety & Quality Management System (FSQMS) to meet and exceed FDA, FSMA, GFSI (such as SQF, BRC, or FSSC 22000), Organic, and customer requirements. Partnering cross-functionally with Operations, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Product Development, and Commercial teams, this leader mitigates microbiological and physical hazards, drives operational excellence, and supports new beverage commercialization. The role fosters a proactive food safety culture and uses data and continuous improvement tools to strengthen product quality, line capability, and regulatory readiness.

The position will be based in **Richmond, CA**.

  

**Main responsibilities**

* Lead Food Safety & Quality Systems: Own and continuously improve the site FSQMS—including HACCP, FSMA Preventive Controls, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), GFSI standards, Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures (SSOPs), Environmental Monitoring Programs (EMP), and allergen control—to maintain audit readiness and full compliance.
* Beverage & Process Quality Oversight: Oversee quality controls across incoming raw ingredients, water/batching, thermal or cold-chain processing, packaging lines, and finished beverages, including traceability and mock recall programs.
* Regulatory & Audit Leadership: Serve as the primary site contact for local, state, FDA, third-party, and customer audits. Lead inspections, regulatory responses, and timely Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) closure.
* Product Safety Authority: Make final decisions on product release, quality holds, deviations, concessions, and disposition. Oversee analytical and microbiological lab testing, sanitation and CIP verification, and hold/release workflows.
* Quality Team Leadership: Build and lead the QA and lab team through mentorship, clear accountability, strategic hiring, structured onboarding, and ongoing skill development.
* Data-Driven Improvement: Establish beverage quality KPIs and use trend analysis, complaint investigation, and root cause analysis to reduce risk, prevent repeat non-conformances, and drive continuous improvement.
* Supplier & Customer Quality: Lead supplier quality programs and manage customer complaint investigations, trend tracking, and resolution.
* Commercialization & Change Management: Partner with R&D, Operations, and Commercial teams on new product launches, packaging or formula trials, and Management of Change (MOC) to verify food safety and quality standards before execution.

  

**What we are searching for**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in food science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or a related field.
* Experience: 5+ years of progressive QA management experience in food, beverage, or bakery manufacturing.
* Certifications: Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) and HACCP required or attainable shortly after hire; GFSI/SQF Practitioner certification preferred.
* Technical & Regulatory Knowledge: Strong command of FDA/FSMA regulations, GMPs, allergen and sanitation controls, lab/microbiological practices, and CAPA/root cause tools.

  

**What is it like at Albertsons?**

Our 290,000 associates have a passion for great service and building lasting relationships with our customers. Through a companywide focus on innovation, we are continually enhancing our digital and product offerings, making it easy for customers to get what they need, wherever they are.

* Coordinate preparation for external audits and reviews, including gathering documentation, tracking requests, organizing responses, and monitoring resolution of findings.
* Track relevant regulatory and contractual changes and recommend updates to policies, documentation standards, and EHR templates.
* Serve as a resource for clinicians and supervisors on documentation standards and payer requirements.

**EHR Oversight**

* Collaborate with the Clinical Director to translate audit findings into targeted training and su

**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs, LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

The Case Manager reports to the Program Director and supports clients by assisting with care and linking them to housing and community resources. The position plays a key role in supporting people moving toward safe, stable housing and greater self-sufficiency. They provide case management services, life skills support, and resource connections and work in partnership with clients to set goals, celebrate progress, and overcome challenges. Using a trauma-informed and a strength-based approach, this position builds trust and respect, making sure clients feel heard, valued, and supported throughout their journey.

Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high-quality, coordinated care. * Connect clients to healthcare providers and community resources, and assist with coordination, scheduling, and transportation as needed.

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Build and maintain partnerships with community organizations, public agencies, and system partners (e.g., VA, APS, CPS, Probation) to support clients and improve access to resources.
* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community stakeholders by sharing information, coordinating services, and promoting trauma-informed care practices.

* **Educational Requirements:** Associate Degree in related field preferred; or High School Diploma/GED with 2-5 years of equivalent experience in related field. * **Technology:** Comfortable using basic technology, including phone and messaging systems, email, Microsoft and Google Suites, and databases to complete administrative tasks and case management, reporting, and tracking outcomes.

**About Foodsmart:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

Our founder, Claudia Muehlenweg, also hosts a bi-weekly YouTube livestream for 103,000 subscribers. The product works. The community loves it. The mission is real.

**A few things to know up front**

Launch seasons get busy. Some of our SOPs need a refresh, and we're in the middle of moving to GoHighLevel, so you'll have a real hand in shaping how things work going forward.

If this sounds like the kind of place you'd enjoy, keep reading.

**This might not be the right fit if...**

* You do your best work with step-by-step direction.

* You'd rather implement every request as-is than talk it through first.

**Lead a remote team and own execution across the business.**

You'll directly manage a remote team of four: a tech VA, an admin VA, a client care specialist, and a social media manager. You'll also work closely with our coaches and program director, coordinating their priorities and making sure their work lines up with the rest of the team's.

Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. ### **Virtual First**

Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.

Think practical HR meets field operations. Not corporate process for process’s sake. The kind of process that is lightweight and useful..

This is a hands-on management role. You’ll lead the guide department, manage the Guide Coordinator, execute day-to-day people operations across the company, and partner closely with the Head of Operations and other Leaders.

And then there’s the other side of the job:

Does it work?

One hour you might be coaching a guide through a difficult guest interaction. The next, you’re tightening an onboarding workflow, reviewing a policy, or solving a missing certification before a departure. Then a sensitive employee issue lands in your inbox. You know what you can resolve, what needs documentation, and what must be escalated.

**What You’ll Own**

**Manage and develop the department Coordinator.** Create clear ownership, priorities, and rhythms for guide administration, scheduling support, certifications, files, onboarding logistics, travel details, gear, receipts, and payroll inputs.

**Run day-to-day people operations.** Own the practical employee lifecycle, including recruiting support, onboarding, documentation, policy rollout, manager support, performance processes, employee relations, and offboarding.

**Build standards and training.** Turn tribal knowledge into clear playbooks, role expectations, training plans, and repeatable systems that make quality easier to deliver across a distributed team.

**Strengthen team member capability.** Give team members tools, coaching, and structure for feedback, documentation, development, accountability, and hard conversations. Step in when the situation requires deeper HR judgment.

**Own guide performance and accountability.** Gather input from Destination Managers and other partners, identify patterns, coach improvement, document concerns, and move discipline forward within the company’s escalation process.

**Plan the guide workforce.** Translate the tour calendar into hiring, readiness, staffing, and development needs. Help the company build the right bench before demand becomes an emergency.

**Create reliable people data and records.** Maintain confidential, accurate systems for personnel files, agreements, certifications, training completion, performance documentation, and other required records.

**Streamline guide operations.** Find the handoffs, duplicate work, missing owners, and recurring fire drills. Design practical workflows that make the guide experience smoother and the business easier to run.

**Protect payroll and finance handoffs.** Ensure guide days, rates, allowances, reimbursements, and other payroll inputs are complete, supported, and delivered on time to Operations and Finance.

**Partner across Product and Operations.** Work laterally with Destination Managers on guide feedback and HR processes while respecting that they report to the Director of Travel Product & Guest Experience. Resolve cross-functional issues with the Head of Operations when ownership or priorities conflict.

**Stay close to the work.** You will inherit processes that are still being built. You should be comfortable doing the work, documenting it, improving it, and then creating the structure that allows others to own the right pieces.

**You Might Be Our Person If...**

You’ve led people in the real world. You know that good management is not simply being supportive. It is setting clear expectations, noticing patterns, giving direct feedback, documenting what matters, and following through.

You have practical HR range. Hiring, onboarding, policies, training, performance management, employee relations, investigations, documentation, leave questions, and compliance are familiar territory. You do not need to be the final authority on every issue, but you know how to assess risk and when to escalate.

You can turn ambiguity into a process people will actually use.

You can write a policy without making it sound like it was written by a robot. You can build a training that changes behavior instead of simply checking a box.

You’re comfortable with seasonal, remote, field-based, or hospitality teams. You understand that the people closest to the guest often work far from headquarters, make decisions in real time, and need both trust and standards.

You can be warm and direct at the same time.

You don’t avoid hard conversations. You prepare for them, handle them respectfully, and make the next step clear.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager

Fullpath by Cox Automotive is a fast growing tech company in the automotive space with hubs across the US and Israel. We are disrupting the multi-trillion dollar transportation industry with our advanced Customer Data Platform (CDP) . Our work happens in the fast lane as we bring AI-powered, data-driven solutions to a quickly evolving industry.

If you are a creative, solutions oriented individual who is ready to put your career in drive, Fullpath is the place for you!

As a Business Operations Analyst on the Operations team, you’ll work at the center of how Fullpath runs, connecting our data and systems with the day-to-day operations of the business. jobs.title: Infrastructure Operations Manager
jobs.description:
MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Manager of Infrastructure Operations to join our team.

The Manager of Infrastructure Operations will leverage deep technical expertise in systems administration and endpoint management to oversee the health, optimization, and modernization of our enterprise IT environment. You will guide a team of engineers across endpoint management, system infrastructure, and automation initiatives while driving cloud expansion and collaborating cross-functionally with security and architecture teams to support mission objectives.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Administering and optimizing enterprise endpoint management platforms, including client and server environment health, agent deployment, software packaging, relay affiliation, and endpoint compliance
* Leading enterprise patch management strategies across Windows and Linux environments while troubleshooting overlapping security tools and Group Policies
* Providing best-practice deployment and integration guidance for asset and endpoint management tools including BigFix, SCCM, Intune, Jamf, ServiceNow, and Rapid7
* Monitoring and maintaining system status across all infrastructure subsystems, recommending architecture upgrades, and leading transitions from on-premises solutions to modern cloud environments
* Performing data validation, warehousing, and data mining to improve data consistency, address gaps, and manage solution dependencies across the IT enterprise
* Coordinating with the Service Desk on enterprise deployments and the Enterprise Information Security team on vulnerability remediation while authoring comprehensive technical documentation
* Leading informal team training to eliminate single points of failure, presenting project statuses to stakeholders, and providing high-touch escalation support for executive leadership

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software, Mathematics, or Physics with 7+ years of progressive engineering experience in systems integration and analysis (including military hardware/software systems and processes), and at least 5+ years as a systems administrator or systems engineer
* 2+ years of experience leading system design, integration, and analytical efforts
* Proficient in loading, configuring, and maintaining Windows and Linux Servers
* 2+ years of strong experience with Active Directory, Group Policy Administration, VMware Virtualization (vSphere, vCenter), and Storage Area Network (SAN) environments
* 2+ years of experience with common networking protocols, including configuring Port Security and VLANs

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proven experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in enterprise-level endpoint management tools and large-scale patch management solutions, including expert-level knowledge in the BigFix framework, Relevance, ActionScript, and custom Web Reports
* High proficiency in PowerShell and/or Python for automating routine administration tasks, paired with a strong understanding of APIs and formal change management processes
* Solid understanding of endpoint security concepts, defense-in-depth strategies, and modern software packaging and deployment methodologies
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft, VMware, ITIL, CISSP) and an innovative mindset for uncovering efficiencies across cross-functional teams

**Clearance Requirements:**

* US Citizen with the ability to obtain a Secret clearance

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while operating computer equipment and managing systems.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Operations (Remote)
jobs.description:
The **Program Manager of Operations (Cross-Zone Execution)** is a strategic operator on the Cross-Zone Execution team in Operations, which builds the metrics, review forums, playbooks, and engagements that help owners across Aledade deliver on company strategy. Aledade’s work sits in four zones (Performance, Transformation, Incubation, and Foundational), and every department has work in every zone. This role helps owners see how their work is performing, diagnose why a metric is off (“Heart of the Problem”), and decide what to do about it, while the accountable owner stays accountable. The role partners directly with senior leaders and helps build the operating infrastructure of a team that is still being designed. It starts in either metrics and forums or engagements and delivery, and works across both as the team matures.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the U.S. or from our office in Bethesda, MD.

### **Primary Duties:**

* Owns the metric record for each metric in scope, including its definition, owner, source system, target, and review forum, and reconciles definition and gross-versus-net differences before they reach a forum. Keeps the executive dashboard current and accurate, using AI tools to automate status collection and draft pre-reads. Leads the mechanics of review forums, including pre-reads, agendas, decisions, and actions, and tracks actions to closure. Spots variance early and routes it to the metric owner and the Director with a clear recommendation.
* Leads short engagements for owners who ask for help: gathers data, frames the root of the problem (or “Heart of the Problem”), tests competing explanations, writes a one-page scope with an exit date, and drafts recommendations for handoff to the accountable business owner. Tracks funded investments against milestones and flags slippage before the forum. When approved, leads end-to-end projects through plan, dependencies, and readiness to a planned handoff.
* Builds and refines the team’s templates, playbooks, and standards, including Aledade's decision making framework, the meeting standard, and “Heart of the Problem” worksheets. Delivers clinics and onboarding for requesters, coaches colleagues, collects feedback and improves the materials.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
* Alternatively, a Master's degree with 6 years of related experience.
* Ability to travel 10-25% of the time

### **Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:**

* Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders
* Structured problem-solving: able to separate competing explanations and say what evidence would tell them apart
* Comfort with data: working in spreadsheets and BI tools, and spotting definition and data errors
* Curiosity and practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day operating work
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders
* Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes

### **Physical Requirements:**

* Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity:**

  

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Onboarding & Implementation**

* Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.
* Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.
* Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.
* Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.
* Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

**Client Experience**

* Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.
* Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.
* Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.
* Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.
* Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.
* Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.
* Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

**Process Improvement & Enablement**

* Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.

* Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.

=====================

We are staffing a multi-year, large-scale project to install and test fiber optic and structured cabling infrastructure inside an AI data center campus in Louisiana. The Data Center Project Coordinator provides administrative, logistical, and deployment support for National OnDemand’s data center program. The position coordinates technician mobilization, travel, lodging, workforce schedules, training and compliance documentation, and daily administrative activities needed to support Corning project work. The role serves as a central coordination point among the Program Management Office, Project Management, Human Resources, Recruiting, Payroll, field leadership, technicians, and other internal partners.  
  
  

**Primary Position Duties:**
============================

* **Technician Deployment and Mobilization**

* Maintain current deployment rosters that identify employee assignments, positions, rotations, mobilization dates, shifts, and status.
* Confirm that employees complete required onboarding, training, documentation, and project-specific requirements before deployment.
* Track upcoming mobilizations, rotations, demobilizations, replacements, and staffing gaps, and communicate changes promptly to project leadership and affected employees.

* Track workforce availability and assist with replacements when employees are unavailable, reassigned, or removed from the project.
* Coordinate relevant schedule information with Human Resources and Payroll to support accurate employee records and timekeeping.
* Maintain current employee contact and emergency information for deployed personnel.
* **Training and Compliance Coordination**
* Track completion of required company, customer, site-specific, safety, technical, and data center training.
* Coordinate attendance for required training and maintain related training and certification records.
* Track background checks, drug screens, site access requirements, and other required deployment documentation.
* Notify appropriate leadership when an employee has not satisfied deployment or access requirements.

* Maintain organized electronic project files, employee rosters, deployment trackers, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and distribute staffing, deployment, training, lodging, and exception reports as requested.
* Support project meetings by preparing rosters, reports, meeting materials, and action-item trackers.
