jobs.title: Care Team Intake Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Synapticure**

Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

Our business is powered by two connected engines.

**The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)**

A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

**The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)**

Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.

### **About the Role**

Synapticure is dedicated to ensuring all individuals living with neurodegenerative diseases have equitable access to the highest standard of care while fueling the advancement of personalized treatments. We create a guided, compassionate journey for every patient, caregiver, and family, educating and empowering them while facilitating access to critical tests and leading specialists across the United States.

As a Care Team Intake Specialist, you will be the welcoming first point of contact for members, caregivers, and loved ones navigating neurodegenerative conditions. You will drive essential clinical and administrative support functions, including scheduling, registration, referrals, and prior authorizations, serving as a trusted representative of Synapticure to our members, external healthcare organizations, and payer partners.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful, daily impact on people's lives within a mission-driven, rapidly evolving environment. We are looking for an empathetic, curious, and organized communicator who thrives in collaborative spaces and is committed to delivering respectful, culturally responsive, and accessible care to diverse communities.

### **The Day to Day**

**Member Engagement & Care Coordination**

* Conduct welcoming, empathetic intake calls with new patients and caregivers to gather medical histories, current and past provider details, and insurance information.
* Schedule, confirm, and manage clinical appointments across virtual platforms, ensuring daily scheduling benchmarks and protocols are met.
* Proactively manage cancellations, rescheduling requests, and appointment reminders via phone, video, and digital communication tools.
* Collaborate closely with the multidisciplinary care team to coordinate care, complete visit-related tasks, and execute FMLA forms.
* Advocate on behalf of patients and families with clinical providers, billing departments, and insurance partners while maintaining strict adherence to HIPAA guidelines.

**Operations, Documentation & Follow-Up**

* Request, collect, and audit external medical records, member consents, and HIPAA forms to ensure care teams have complete information prior to appointments.
* Conduct insurance eligibility checks and assist with prior authorizations and referral management.
* Accurately document member clinical and demographic data, calls, and correspondence in our Electronic Health Record (EHR) and care facilitation platforms in a timely manner.
* Manage incoming and outgoing communications, including faxes, digital messages, and mailed member resources.
* Follow standardized operating procedures and quality assurance protocols while remaining adaptable to evolving workflows and priorities.
* Generate standard operational reports and support additional care team initiatives as needed.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 1-2+ years of experience in patient communication, care coordination, medical scheduling, or managing referrals and prior authorizations.
* Comfort with digital communication tools, telehealth platforms, Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, and standard office technology.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA privacy guidelines and handling confidential medical records.
* Strong active listening skills and the ability to communicate clearly, patiently, and non-judgmentally with individuals from diverse backgrounds and varying accessibility needs.
* Ability to stay organized, prioritize tasks effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in a healthcare setting, such as a Medical Assistant (MA), Patient Care Coordinator, Medical Records Specialist, or similar clinical/administrative support role.
* Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical terminology, FMLA documentation, and frequently prescribed medications.
* Experience requesting, reviewing, and auditing external medical records for completeness and accuracy.
* Hands-on proficiency with cloud-based EHR systems (e.g., Epic, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks), macOS, and Google Workspace.
* Experience working in a remote setting, startup, or mission-driven organization undergoing rapid growth and change.

### **Schedule**

We are looking for candidates who are flexible to work the below schedule, based on your time zone, Monday through Friday.

* Pacific: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM PT
* Mountain: 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM MT
* Central: 10

### **About Profound Research**

Profound Research partners with community physicians to offer clinical trials as a therapeutic option for their patients. We handle all infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and administrative operations so physicians can focus on patient care. Our model gives patients access to the newest therapies while maintaining the trusted patient-physician relationship.

**Our Mission:** Improving Lives by Providing Advanced Therapeutic Options

**Our Vision:** Creating the Absolute Best Patient-Physician Experience in Clinical Research

**Our Values:**

* **Compassion:** We prioritize the patient-physician relationship, ensuring every interaction is service-oriented and patient-centered.
* **Urgency:** We work hard and practice selflessness, acting swiftly and decisively to meet the needs of our patients, partners, and colleagues.
* **Solution Orientation:** We embrace challenges with a positive mindset, communicate directly, and identify and implement effective solutions with efficiency.
* **Excellence:** We insist on excellence, holding ourselves accountable and empowering each other to deliver best-in-class service while maintaining the highest ethical and scientific standards.

### **Why This Role Exists**

The Patient Engagement Specialist (Centralized) owns patient engagement and recruitment across assigned studies and sites, from first contact with a prospective participant through pre-screening, scheduling, and follow-up into clinical screening. Working from the centralized Patient Engagement team, this role supports multiple clinical trial sites at once.

For many prospective participants, this role is their first conversation with Profound Research. The Specialist decides how to reach and engage each person, creates a responsive and patient-centered experience, and supports sites in meeting enrollment goals.

**What You’ll Own**

Patient Recruitment & Pre-Screening

* Own recruitment for assigned studies and sites, including inbound and outbound outreach, pre-screening, scheduling, and follow-up through the handoff into clinical screening

* Assess prospective participants against protocol eligibility criteria and determine whether to advance, hold, or close each candidate, escalating clinical questions to the appropriate resource

* Build and apply working knowledge of assigned protocols, eligibility criteria, medical terminology, and study-specific recruitment considerations

* Provide prospective participants with clear, accurate, and approved information about study participation and next steps

* Deliver a compassionate and professional patient experience across every conversation

**Recruitment Funnel & Priorities**

* Decide how to sequence outreach and follow-up across studies and sites when demands compete, based on patient status, study urgency, and enrollment impact

* Identify barriers affecting patient progression and adjust day-to-day approach when results indicate something is not working

* Escalate recruitment barriers, capacity constraints, and competing priorities with enough context to support a timely decision

* Communicate recruitment progress, patient trends, and operational concerns to site and Patient Engagement stakeholders

**Site & Team Coordination**

* Experience in a role requiring frequent direct contact with patients, customers, or the public, including academic, volunteer, or part-time work

* Clear verbal and written communication with a professional and compassionate phone presence

* Comfort working in a high-volume outreach environment, both inbound and outbound

* Ability to learn and apply study protocols, eligibility criteria, and medical terminology

* Sound independent judgment in managing patient situations, competing priorities, and day-to-day recruitment decisions

* Strong organization and attention to detail while managing several studies and sites at once

* Comfort learning and working across multiple systems

* Ability to work effectively and stay connected to colleagues and site teams in a remote environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associate degree or higher

* Experience in clinical research patient recruitment or engagement

* Experience in healthcare outreach, patient access, scheduling, call center, sales, or other performance-driven environment

* Experience conducting chart or schedule reviews in an electronic medical record system

* Experience supporting multi-site clinical research operations

* Experience using a clinical trial management system, patient tracking system, or third-party recruitment platform

**Company Description**

Florida Health Information Exchange (FLHIE) is Florida’s state-designated Health Information Exchange (HIE). FLHIE enables the secure and reliable sharing of health information across Florida’s healthcare ecosystem, connecting providers, patients, payers, and public health agencies statewide. Through these connections, FLHIE helps improve care coordination, enhance quality and safety, and support more efficient healthcare delivery. FLHIE is an affiliate of CRISP Shared Services, a technology partner for multiple HIEs across the nation.

  

**Job Summary**

The Account Manager is responsible for driving customer success, adoption and growth across the Florida HIE customer base. This role drives trusted partnerships with payers, accountable care organizations, physician practices, long term care providers, hospitals, and other healthcare organizations to ensure HIE tools are implemented, fully adopted, and deliver measurable value. Therefore, prior experience working with, or in, at least one of these stakeholder groups is highly preferred.

The Account Manager strengthens satisfaction and retention by supporting the improvement of data quality, accelerating utilization, and building trusted relationships across stakeholders within the broader Florida HIE ecosystem to expand CRISP Shared Services footprint and impact.

The Account Manager is a self-starter with consultant’s eye for problem-solving. The health care space in Florida is extremely dynamic and requires an eye for detail when it comes to onboarding complex organizations with different lines of business and services, that each have distinct needs. It’s critical to be thoughtful and active listener, take great notes, and have excellent follow-up and follow-through.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* **Build and maintain deep expertise in HIE tools and services and customer data systems (Salesforce)** to proactively drive adoption, utilization, and measurable client contact and value across the region’s healthcare landscape.
* **Plan and execute targeted outreach (calls, emails, and in person meetings)** with current and prospective Florida HIE participants (payers, accountable care organizations, physician practices, long term care providers, hospitals, and other healthcare organizations) to strengthen relationships, increase participation, engagement, and reinforce ongoing use of CRISP Shared Services tools.
* **Own onboarding success for new Florida customers,** ensuring rapid time to value by addressing questions early, identifying adoption barriers, validating patient panel submission, and enabling the right staff to effectively use CRISP Shared Services HIE data in day to day workflows.
* **Partner closely with CRISP Support and technical teams** to coordinate seamless onboarding, resolve issues quickly, and maintain accurate documentation that supports sustained utilization.
* **Act as the voice of the customer,** systematically capturing feedback, use cases, and improvement opportunities from users and translating them into actionable insights for CRISP Shared Services development, support, and outreach teams to improve customer experience.
* **Maintain high quality customer data in Salesforce and related systems**, using insights to track adoption trends, identify growth opportunities, maintain accurate client accounts and inform engagement strategies.
* **Represent CRISP at meetings, forums, and events,** strengthening ecosystem relationships with providers, partners, and stakeholders and expanding CRISP’s visibility and influence across the region.
* **Collaborate with leadership** to design and execute engagement strategies that increase satisfaction, deepen utilization, and grow CRISP’s ambulatory footprint in the identified region.
* **Support training and onboarding of new HIE participants and team members** ensuring consistent messaging, strong customer interactions, and scalable support across the regional ecosystem.
* **Travel locally within Florida** as needed to support relationship building, onboarding, and strategic engagement.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* **Exceptional communicator** with the ability to clearly articulate value, build trust, and drive action through both written and verbal communication.
* **Advanced customer relationship management expertis**e, including the ability to proactively manage accounts, influence adoption behavior, and translate customer needs into meaningful outcomes.
* **Strong organizational and interpersonal presence**, capable of effectively engaging stakeholders at all levels—externally with customers and partners, and internally across technical, support, and leadership teams.
* **High productivity, adaptable, and solutions oriented mindset,** demonstrating creativity, sound judgment, and flexibility in a fast moving, relationship driven environment.
* **Proven ability to juggle multiple priorities,** execute against deadlines, and maintain momentum across simultaneous customer initiatives.
* **Strong technical fluency with business tools,** including Microsoft Office, CRM platforms (especially Salesforce), and database or spreadsheet software, to track performance, surface insights, and guide strategy.

**interos.ai**

**About interos.ai**
--------------------

interos.ai is the supply chain risk intelligence company, building the most trusted and transparent supply chains in the world. Our discovery and monitoring intelligence spans the lifecycle of supply chain risk, enabling faster and more informed threat mitigation. As the world's first, and only, automated supplier intelligence platform, we continuously map and monitor extended supply chains at speed and scale. jobs.title: Onboarding Technician
jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**

Lumistry began as a phone system for independent pharmacies and grew, product by product, into the communication and workflow platform those pharmacies run on today. Each addition answered a problem pharmacists told us about: phones that never stop ringing, education that gets thrown away, patients who drift to the chains.

Today, Lumistry serves more than 9,000 pharmacies with technology built for pharmacy. Our solutions help pharmacies engage patients, automate work, improve health literacy, reduce operating costs, and grow their businesses. Now we are using AI to take repetitive work off pharmacy teams so they can spend more time with patients.

**The Opportunity**

You know how much of the day goes to repetitive tasks in the pharmacy management system (PMS), like processing refills and entering e-scripts. Our AI-powered automation does that work for the pharmacy team.

As an Onboarding Technician, you instruct an automation agent on how each pharmacy works. You map out each task step by step, think through every “if this happens, then do that,” build it in our workflow builder, and keep it running smoothly once it goes live. The job sits between two worlds. On one side are pharmacy technicians who know their PMS cold but do not think in terms of automation logic. On the other is an automation that will do exactly what you tell it, in exactly the order you tell it, and will stop when reality does not match what you wrote.

Your job is to turn the first into the second, prove it works, and fix it fast when it breaks.

**What You'll Do**

* Set up new pharmacies on our platform and make sure the device that runs their automation is connected and ready.
* Meet with pharmacy teams, learn how they work in their PMS, and map each task step by step, including the decisions and exceptions along the way.
* Build, test, and update automated workflows in our workflow builder for each PMS we support.
* Work with our engineers on the technical pieces, like how the automation recognizes PMS screens and fields, and confirm everything works in the pharmacy.
* Check automation runs every day, figure out why something stopped or failed, and fix it.
* Update workflows when a PMS releases a new version.
* Help grow a library of proven workflow templates so each new pharmacy goes live faster.
* Escalate issues you cannot solve, with screenshots, the step that failed, and what you have already tried.

**What You Bring**

* Pharmacy experience using a pharmacy management system (PMS).
* Logical, critical thinking. You can break a process into steps, think through every “if this, then that,” and figure out why something works nine times out of 10 but fails on the tenth.
* The ability to interview pharmacy staff about how they work: ask follow-up questions, catch the steps they skip because they are second nature, and confirm what you heard.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write instructions others can follow and can calmly explain an issue to a pharmacy.

**Other Details**

* Business hours across U.S. time zones, with occasional after-hours work for go-lives, PMS updates, and a shared on-call rotation as we grow.
* Occasional travel to pharmacies to set up devices and see workflows firsthand.
* You will be trained on our tools and workflows, and your skills in automation and AI will grow with the product.

**Compensation**

The approximate range for this role is $70,000 to $75,000.

### **Benefits**

Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

### **Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry**

Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

### **Accessibility**

We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please reach out.

**Ecology Center Background:**

The Ecology Center's mission is to inspire and build a sustainable, healthy, and just future for the East Bay, California, and beyond. Since 1970, we've transformed sustainability ideas into everyday practice, offering actionable information, reliable infrastructure, and leadership for lasting change. We operate the nation's first curbside recycling service, nationally recognized food and farming programs, and model education, engagement, and youth development activities.

**Role Overview:**

The Farmers' Market Access and Equity Program Coordinator works under the direction of the Farmers' Market AccessEquity Program Manager, in coordination with the Food and Farming Program Director, to assist with all aspects relating to the Ecology Center's work promoting healthy food access at California farmers' markets. The Farmers' Markets Access and Equity Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize Federal Assistance Benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved populations and drive additional customers/income to small and mid-sized family farmers.

The Ecology Center is actively working to create and promote an alternative food system that is based on the values of environmental protection, justice, and access to healthy, sustainably produced food for all. The Farmers' Markets AccessEquity Program (FMAE) seeks to create greater healthy food choices for low-income and underserved Californians while also supporting small and mid-sized family farms. The FMAE Program Coordinator works to establish, implement, promote, and incentivize SNAP benefit use at farmers' markets and other direct marketing outlets. The FMAE Program Coordinator performs job duties in support of the Ecology Center's work supporting healthy food access at California farmers' markets, including the Market Match Program, Farmers' Market EBT/SNAP access programming , and the FMFinder.org tool. new_jobs.title: Implementation Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Hively’s mission is to build meaningful connections with families and communities, ensuring access to resources every child in Alameda County needs to thrive. Our vision is to transform the lives of children and families to benefit all communities and ensure a promising future for generations to come. We believe that through subsidized child care, mental health support, and community services centered in families of all types and backgrounds, we can profoundly impact the communities we serve. If this resonates with you, we invite you to apply to join our team.

**Our Team & Culture**

Our Team at Hively is a passionate and diverse group of individuals from a wide range of different lived experiences, backgrounds and professional expertise. We strive every day to create an environment for families and staff that is inclusive and welcoming of different experiences and perspectives. We prioritize learning, listening, and growing together and to foster a culture of respect.

**The Opportunity**

The Implementation Program Manager will serve as a key member of the Hively launch team in the administration of the Measure C Subsidized Child Care and Minimum Wage Floor and Operating Grants program, funded and overseen by First 5 Alameda County.

With an annual budget of $85 million, this exciting program is designed to stabilize and strengthen Alameda County’s child care provider landscape through two related arms: (1) distribution and filling of subsidized child care slots (Contracted Slots) and (2) implementation of a minimum wage floor and operating grants (Operating Grants). The first arm expands access to high-quality, subsidized child care by funding openings for an estimated 1,400 children, from birth to age five, across Alameda County. The second arm establishes a $25/hour minimum wage floor for eligible child care providers and offers operating grants to support program participation.

Working closely with the VP of New Ventures and program Directors, the Implementation Manager will help turn the initiative’s vision, policies, and requirements into the systems, processes, and day-to-day operations needed to successfully launch and manage a large-scale public program. The Manager will take ownership of major operational workstreams, help solve problems as they arise, and ensure that important details do not get lost as the program moves from planning and development into testing, piloting, and full-scale operations.

The position will focus primarily on the subsidized child care slot arm, while working closely with the Operating Grants, Technology, Communications, and Finance teams, particularly during the initial program launch. Given the newness of the program, this Manager may be called on to serve as a generalist, capable of floating between teams to fill emerging needs. As the program matures, the Manager may help build and lead a team and manage day-to-day operations in a specialized area, including the subsidized child care slot arm, RBA management, or an alternative complementary role.

The ideal candidate is a resourceful, hands-on manager who is comfortable taking on a wide range of responsibilities in a fast-moving environment. They can move easily between big-picture planning and detailed execution, take initiative without waiting for direction, and bring structure to ambiguous, complex or changing situations. They are equally comfortable developing a program-wide process, writing a step-by-step staff guide, troubleshooting a technology or provider payment issue, or helping a new team member understand their responsibilities. They are motivated to learn on the fly, and inspired to be on the ground floor of a transformational initiative.

### **What you will do:**

**Program Leadership & Implementation**

* Serve as a senior operational partner, helping lead the planning, launch, and ongoing implementation of the program.
* Take ownership of major operational workstreams, translating program policies and funding requirements into day-to-day systems and procedures.
* Lead the development and implementation of core program operations, including application intake and review, determining provider and family eligibility, payment processes, reporting, compliance, audits and recertification.
* Work across teams to connect the many moving parts, including technology, finance, provider communications, technical assistance, training, data, and reporting.
* Act as a programmatic liaison for the Coordinated Eligibility and Enrollment (CEE) integration, aligning subsidized child care slot implementation procedures with emerging technology requirements.
* Identify problems, make recommendations, and take action to keep implementation on track. Escalate significant issues to program leadership with proposed solutions.
* Step in wherever needed to address immediate program needs, particularly during the start-up phase (anticipated to last approximately six months).

**Program Documentation and Deliverables**

* Lead the development of clear and comprehensive program procedures, staff manuals, provider guidelines, user guides, toolkits, and training materials.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation as policies, systems, and program requirements change.
* Author major components of deliverables, including implementation procedures and operational reports.
* Collaborate with the Technology team to ensure seamless record-level data integration, automated reporting, status dashboards, and disaggregated metrics (e.g., geography, demographics, provider types) to assess equity and performance.
* Support required program reporting and performance tracking, including Results-Based Accountability (RBA) measures.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor program operations and performance to identify issues, delays, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead efforts to improve workflows, technology, provider support, and internal processes throughout program phases.

### **Position description**

Professional Researcher
  
Family and Community Medicine
  
University of California, San Francisco

Position Start Date: January 1, 2027 or as negotiated.

The Person-Centered Reproductive Health Program within the UCSF Department of Family & Community Medicine announces a search for a Professional Researcher, a non-faculty academic position. Appointment will be at the Assistant rank. This position is based in San Francisco, CA, and is a full-time position (with some protected time for independent research); the initial appointment will be for two years.

The Assistant Professional Researcher will assist the Principal Investigators, Dr. Christine Dehlendorf, Professor, and Dr. Rachel Logan, Assistant Professor, in the Department of Family and Community Medicine, on a number of studies focused on person-centered contraceptive care including the Postpartum Contraception NIH Grant, the INTERACT project, and a series of projects exploring how best to offer HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis to cisgender women and service users in reproductive health and primary care settings.

The successful candidate should have a strong background in qualitative and mixed methods research to help lead the formative research component of this research program. Working in close collaboration with the study Principal Investigators, candidate will develop qualitative and qualitative survey instruments, perform quantitative and qualitative data analysis, facilitate community and stakeholder engagement, and contribute to manuscript drafting and editing. In addition, and with guidance from the Project Director, they will oversee the administration of the projects, including data management and compliance with research regulations (such as human subjects protection).

The successful applicant will have the opportunity to contribute substantively to the intellectual work of the studies, participating fully in study design, oversight of data collection, analysis, and research publications. In collaboration with study PIs, the fellow may also propose supplemental research questions or activities that may contribute to their own research agenda, subject to feasibility. * Participate in and co-lead data analysis, report writing, and research publications.
* Oversee compliance with research regulations (such as human subjects protection).
* Present research findings at meetings, seminars, and conferences.

  

* Organize and co-lead study team meetings.
* Carry out independent and/or collaborative research.

Qualifications include:

* Ability to collaborate across disciplines and institutions, while working independently.

new_jobs.title: Teleoperations Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Mind**
--------------

Mind Robotics is building Physical AI for real-world industrial deployment, starting with the factory floor. We believe the hardest problems in AI are solved when researchers and engineers are hands-on with the physical world every day - and we're looking for people who are passionate about robotics, value ownership, and are excited to tackle difficult problems. Join us if you want to move beyond digital intelligence and put intelligence into motion.

**About the team and the role**
-------------------------------

Teleoperations is how Mind collects its own robot training data. Our robot operators drive Mind's robots through real manufacturing tasks, producing the demonstration data our robot foundation models learn from. The Teleoperations Operations team runs the rapidly growing team.

As Teleoperations Operations Lead, you will own the collection floor end to end and report directly to Daniel Burrows, Head of Data. You will turn collection programs into a reliable, high-quality flow of training data: hiring and scheduling the team, running both shifts, keeping robots and stations up, and holding the floor to clear throughput and quality targets. You will also write the operating playbook we use to open new collection sites. This is a chance to build and scale the operation that feeds Mind's models, at the point where research meets the physical world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Run daily collection operations.** Own the teleoperation floor across the day and swing shifts: shift plans, station assignments, task queues and hand-offs, so every station is collecting usable data during every scheduled hour.
* **Hit throughput and quality targets.** Set and track operating metrics such as usable hours of data per shift, station utilization, episode success rate and rejection rate. Diagnose drops and fix them with changes to process, staffing or tooling.
* **Build and lead the team.** Hire, onboard and manage staff robot operators, core data collectors, shift leads, a people operations lead and a prop master. Grow the team with clear levels, career paths and performance management.
* **Train and certify operators.** Design training and certification for new robots, tasks and control interfaces, and run regular calibration sessions so operators produce consistent, high-quality demonstrations.
* **Turn collection programs into execution.** Partner with the Teleoperations Program team and our researchers to translate data requests (task, environment, embodiment, volume and deadline) into floor layouts, scene and prop setups, and schedules, and give early feedback on feasibility and cost.
* **Own data quality at the source.** Work with our Annotation & Labelling and Data Quality teams to define episode acceptance criteria, run QA and spot checks on the floor, and close the loop on issues found downstream.
* **Keep robots and stations running.** Work with hardware, robotics and data infrastructure engineers on uptime: triage robot, rig and software failures, manage spares and preventive maintenance, and track downtime and its root causes.
* **Own safety on the floor.** Run the safety program for the collection floor, including robot safety procedures, incident reporting and operator ergonomics, and keep the site compliant as it grows.
* **Plan capacity.** Model headcount, shift coverage and station capacity against the data plan, and run a weekly operating review and a quarterly capacity plan.
* **Scale to new sites.** Write the operating playbook (staffing model, training, QA and tooling) and help stand up additional collection sites as the program grows.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in operations, including 4+ years leading multi-shift teams of 20 or more people, with shift leads or managers reporting to you.
* Experience running hands-on operations in robotics, autonomous vehicles, hardware, manufacturing, or ML data collection or labeling (for example AV test fleets, robot data collection, or warehouse automation).
* Track record of setting and hitting throughput, quality and uptime targets, and of using SQL, spreadsheets or dashboards to analyze operating data yourself.
* Experience designing training and certification programs for a skilled technical workforce.
* Working knowledge of robot and machinery safety practices (for example ISO 10218, ANSI/RIA R15.06 and lockout/tagout) and experience running a site safety program.
* Experience hiring quickly and building processes from scratch in a fast-growing company.
* Clear written and verbal communication with operators, engineers, researchers and executives.

* Serve on the Compliance Committee; draft, update, and maintain clinical compliance policies and procedures in coordination with organizational leadership.
* Coordinate preparation for external audits and reviews, including gathering documentation, tracking requests, organizing responses, and monitoring resolution of findings.
* Track relevant regulatory and contractual changes and recommend updates to policies, documentation standards, and EHR templates.
* Serve as a resource for clinicians and supervisors on documentation standards and payer requirements.

* Coordinate with clinical leadership and administrative staff regarding EHR changes that affect clinical practice and documentation.

ZEDEDA unlocks the value of AI where it matters most, enabling enterprises to create, secure and operate edge AI at scale. For more information, visit www.ZEDEDA.ai.

### **Role Summary**

We're hiring an Office Manager to keep our San Jose office running smoothly and make it a place people want to be. You'll be the first face guests see and the person the team relies on to get things done. Working closely with our Chief of Staff to the CEO and our People team, you'll own the day-to-day of the office and help shape how it runs as we grow.

This is a **temp-to-hire** role, hired with the goal of converting to a permanent position. It's a great fit for someone **earlier in their career** who notices what needs doing and does it before anyone asks.

### **Core Responsibilities**

* **Run the office day to day:** keep supplies stocked, the space organized, and mail, deliveries and building access working.
* **Manage vendors:** be the main contact for facilities, cleaning, catering, IT hardware and office suppliers. Handle scheduling, follow-ups and invoices.
* **Welcome people:** greet visitors, candidates and customers, and set up meeting rooms so every visit goes smoothly.

* **Bring people together:** plan team lunches, celebrations and on-site events.
* **Keep things organized:** track orders, budgets and recurring tasks so nothing slips.

* About 1 to 3 years of experience in office, administrative, hospitality, front desk or customer service roles.
* Observant: you spot problems early and fix them without being asked.
* Warm and social: you enjoy being the person people come to.
* Organized, with clear written and verbal communication with vendors and teammates.
* Able to work on site in San Jose 5 days a week.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in a startup or fast-paced environment, and you like the pace and ownership that come with it.
* Comfortable with everyday tools (Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, Slack).
* A college degree is welcome but not required. We care more about how you work than where you studied.

* **Shape the place.** How the office runs, how guests are welcomed and how the team comes together will be yours to build.

* **A clear path to full-time.** We're hiring with the goal of converting this role to a permanent position.
* **A downtown home base.** Our HQ is close to restaurants, light rail and Caltrain connections.

* **Health coverage:** medical (Anthem PPO and HSA-eligible plans), dental and vision
* **Pre-tax accounts:** Health Savings Account, Health and Limited-Purpose FSA, and Dependent Care FSA

This person needs to have a strong understanding and ability to identify patient medical information. This role requires the ability to independently interpret medical terminology, which may include but is not limited to an understanding of past medical histories, diagnosis, laboratory, and pathology results. **About Foodsmart:**  
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

* Manage and resolve escalations from clients, vendors, and internal teams, and keep everyone updated until each one is closed

new_jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity:**

  

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Onboarding & Implementation**

* Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.
* Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.
* Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.
* Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.
* Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

**Client Experience**

* Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.
* Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.
* Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.
* Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.
* Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.
* Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.
* Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

**Process Improvement & Enablement**

* Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.
* Create client-facing onboarding materials and training guides built around multifamily workflows.
* Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.
* Act as the team’s subject matter expert on onboarding, sharing best practices with Client Success team members.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

In your first year, success means:

* New properties go live on schedule, meet SLAs, and start with strong satisfaction and health scores.
* The playbooks, SOPs, and automations you build are adopted across Client Services.
* You resolve complex, multi-property launch issues on your own and keep internal teams on track through tight timelines.
* Teammates count on you as a go-to resource for onboarding.

### **What You'll Need:**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in client onboarding or implementation at a B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services company.
* A track record of leading enterprise or multi-location rollouts from handoff to adoption, including building the playbooks and SOPs behind them.
* Experience coordinating software integrations or data migrations with clients and technical teams.
* Strong organization. You can manage dozens of rollouts at once without letting quality slip, and you use data to spot and fix problems.
* Clear communication, from presenting to executives to explaining complex workflows to non-technical staff.
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing tools, plus hands-on experience with CRM, project management, and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Kustomer).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Multifamily real estate experience, whether in onsite or regional property operations (e.g., Community Manager) or at a PropTech vendor, ideally with NMHC Top 50 owners/operators.
* Experience with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, AppFolio, or ResMan.
* Experience with Salesforce Flow or custom intake forms.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Real Estate, Communications, or a related field.

**Core Competency Profile**

* **Project Management:** Highly organized with superior attention to detail; capable of managing dozens of simultaneous property rollouts without sacrificing quality.
* **Customer-Centric Leadership:** Empathetic listener and skilled communicator capable of simplifying complex workflows for non-technical property staff.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Able to navigate ambiguity, overcome technical blockers, and build constructive relationships across diverse internal and external stakeholders.

### **What We'll Deliver On:**

  

* Competitive base salary plus performance bonus potential
*

**Organizational Overview:** Founded in 1994, the National Latina Institute for Reproductive Justice

(Latina Institute) builds Latine power to fight for the fundamental human right to reproductive

health, dignity, and justice. We center Latine voices, mobilize our communities, transform the

cultural narrative, and drive policy change. We amplify the grassroots power and thought

leadership of Latines across the country to fuel a larger reproductive justice movement.

**Position Overview:** Latina Institute seeks a Communications Project Manager who is passionate

about reproductive justice and social justice to organize our communications efforts and calendars

and keep them on track during both rapid response and proactive campaign moments. Serving as

the central operational hub for the communications team, this role helps our voice come through

consistently across departments, channels, and audiences, in English and Spanish, and helps

communications work as a connector and collaborator. The Communications Project Manager

reports to the Senior Director of Communications and Public Affairs and collaborates closely with

the Government Relations, Community Mobilization, Education, Development, Finance and

Operations teams, as well as external consultants, vendors, and content creators. This is a highly

collaborative role, and the ideal candidate will be self-motivated and able to prioritize tasks and

12-month period is subject to securing additional funding and organizational needs.

**Location and Travel:** Hybrid or remote. We operate as a remote organization but require certain

roles to be based in specific locations. For this position, the candidate must be based in states

alignment meetings by notetaking, tracking completion of do-outs, and reporting outcomes.

* Plan ahead for priority campaigns and proactive projects, and protect time for them, balancing

rapid response with longer-term campaign priorities.

* Align the department calendar with planned cultural and advocacy moments, alongside the

Digital Engagement Strategist.

* Organize rapid response moments by coordinating timelines including drafts, approvals,

spokespeople, and distribution so our voice comes through quickly and consistently during
  
opportune times in collaboration with Communications and Public Affairs Specialist and other
  
Communications team members.  
  

Cross-Departmental Coordination:

* Partner with Government Relations, Community Mobilization, Education, and Development to

* Coordinate communications support for campaigns, reports, events, and trainings, including

**About VersaTech**

VersaTech is a technology solutions provider delivering human-centered solutions that help organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and achieve their missions. We specialize in audiovisual and collaboration technology, AV as a Service, AV design-build, IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI and automation, and end-to-end technology solutions.

Serving federal, state and local government, education, and commercial customers, VersaTech combines technical expertise, dependable service, and a customer-focused approach. Guided by our commitment to Confidence in Every Connection™, our team lives four core values: Can Do!, Customer Focused, Dedicated, and Team First.

VersaTech is seeking an experienced, PMP-certified IT Project Manager to support anticipated opportunities across our federal government customer portfolio. The work environment is dynamic and collaborative, with multiple project teams working toward a common vision to deliver integrated IT solutions.

$125,000 to $160,000 based on experience.

new_jobs.title: SR. Project Manager - Wind Energy / Repower
new_jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager – Wind Energy / Repower

**Company:** Zephyr Wind Services – Zephyr Repower  
**Salary:** $140,000–$160,000 annually  
**Location:** Remote  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Travel:** 30–40%  
**FLSA Status:** Exempt

About Zephyr Wind Services

Zephyr Wind Services is purpose-built to support the wind industry from the ground up. We provide wind drivetrain, generator, and parts solutions designed to reduce downtime at medium and large-scale wind farms. Our field operations deliver comprehensive repower and major corrective services, supporting some of the industry's leading original equipment manufacturers and wind energy operators.

At Zephyr, we are committed to safety, quality, operational excellence, and delivering exceptional results for our customers.

Position Overview

Zephyr is seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to lead complex, utility-scale wind repower and major component projects from initial planning through execution, commissioning, and closeout.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, customer-focused project management professional with direct wind repower experience and a strong understanding of crane operations, field labor, tooling, parts, transportation, and project logistics.

This position requires the ability to independently manage multiple projects, oversee financial and commercial performance, anticipate operational challenges, and drive successful project execution while maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality.

Key Responsibilities

* Independently lead complex wind repower and major component projects from planning through closeout.
* Manage multiple active projects, balancing customer expectations, schedules, budgets, resources, and operational priorities.
* Develop and maintain project execution plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource forecasts.
* Oversee crane coordination, mobilization, field labor planning, tooling, parts, and material requirements.
* Coordinate transportation, equipment deliveries, site logistics, and vendor mobilization.
* Support contract negotiations, contract administration, scope management, and change management activities.
* Monitor project financial performance, including budgets, cost forecasts, labor hours, invoice validation, and profitability.
* Evaluate supplier and subcontractor performance to ensure alignment with project requirements.
* Identify project risks, resource constraints, and critical-path challenges while developing mitigation and recovery strategies.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, vendors, field leadership, and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with EHS, Quality Assurance, Finance, Procurement, and Operations to ensure successful project execution.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to less-experienced Project Managers and project team members.
* Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned and enhanced project management practices.
* Oversee project closeout, documentation, financial reconciliation, and customer handover.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of **5 years of relevant project management experience**.
* **Direct wind repower project experience is required.**
* Demonstrated experience independently managing complex projects, budgets, schedules, and customer relationships.
* Strong working knowledge of crane operations and heavy-lift coordination, field labor, tooling, parts, and materials.
* Experience coordinating transportation, logistics, vendors, and project resources.
* Strong understanding of project financial management, contract administration, and cost control.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent organizational, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with project management, scheduling, and reporting tools.
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30–40%.

Preferred Qualifications

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience with Oracle Primavera P6.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Renewable Energy, Construction Management, Business, or a related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

What Makes You Successful in This Role

* You are highly organized, proactive, and accountable.
* You understand the complexities of wind repower project execution.
* You communicate effectively with customers, field teams, and leadership.
* You anticipate challenges before they impact project execution.
* You balance operational demands with financial and commercial objectives.
* You demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.

Why Join Zephyr?

* Competitive annual salary of $140,000–$160,000.
* Opportunity to lead complex, impactful projects within the renewable energy industry.
* Remote work arrangement with project-related travel.
* Collaborative, team-oriented work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a growing Repower division.
* Professional growth and leadership opportunities.

**If you are an experienced wind energy project management professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about delivering successful projects, we encourage you to apply!**

Pay: $140,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of project management experience do you have?
* Do you have direct experience managing wind repower projects?
* Do you have experience coordinating cranes, field labor, tooling, parts, and materials for wind energy projects?
* Do you have experience managing project budgets, financial forecasts, and contract obligations?
* Are you willing and able to travel 30–40%?
* Do you have experience using Oracle Primavera P6?
* Do you currently hold a PMP certification?

Work Location: Remote

The Program Manager is responsible for providing the end-to-end customer experience for a major account customer, serving as the single point of accountability across installation, training, ongoing service, and contractual performance. This role acts as the executive-level program owner — orchestrating Marco's Project Management, Service, Sales, Account Management, and Billing teams to deliver on every commitment made to the client, with particular emphasis on Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for installation, delivery, training, walk-throughs, and ongoing service.  
Operating at the intersection of the customer and Marco's internal operations, the Program Manager governs a structured cadence of program reviews, escalation management, and continuous improvement activities. This position requires strong business and industry awareness, fluency in managed services and SLA-driven delivery models, and the ability to influence cross-functional teams to maintain consistent, high-quality client experience across a complex, multi-site major account environment.

* General

* Demonstrated ownership of large, multi-site B2B customer accounts with formal SLAs and executive-level governance.
* Working knowledge of large-customer business operations — workflow awareness, IT change control, data privacy considerations, and the rhythm of a complex, multi-site customer environment.
* Experience operating in a matrixed services environment, coordinating across Project Management, Service, Sales, and Finance functions.
* Managed services, managed print services (MPS), enterprise imaging, or enterprise IT services experience strongly preferred.
* Experience with ticketing, ERP, and reporting tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Salesforce, Power BI, ConnectWise, or similar).
* Program Management, Project Management Professional (PMP), PgMP, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Valid Driver's License, proof of personal insurance, and an acceptable driving record.

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

Our business is powered by two connected engines.

**The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)**

A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

**The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)**

Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.

Synapticure is dedicated to ensuring all individuals living with neurodegenerative diseases have equitable access to the highest standard of care while fueling the advancement of personalized treatments. We create a guided, compassionate journey for every patient, caregiver, and family, educating and empowering them while facilitating access to critical tests and leading specialists across the United States.

**Operations, Documentation & Follow-Up**

**Meet the Moment with Alteryx**

**Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in one of the following industries: Consumer Packaged Goods / Retail, Technology Services, Financial Services, or Healthcare.
* Experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer support, technical support, customer success, sales, or implementation.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to lead engaging conversations and understand customer needs.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn new technologies.
A customer-oriented mindset, with empathy, active listening skills, and good organizational abilities.

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

An annual $200 home office reimbursement

new_jobs.title: Onboarding Technician
new_jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**

Lumistry began as a phone system for independent pharmacies and grew, product by product, into the communication and workflow platform those pharmacies run on today. Each addition answered a problem pharmacists told us about: phones that never stop ringing, education that gets thrown away, patients who drift to the chains.

Today, Lumistry serves more than 9,000 pharmacies with technology built for pharmacy. Our solutions help pharmacies engage patients, automate work, improve health literacy, reduce operating costs, and grow their businesses. Now we are using AI to take repetitive work off pharmacy teams so they can spend more time with patients.

**The Opportunity**

You know how much of the day goes to repetitive tasks in the pharmacy management system (PMS), like processing refills and entering e-scripts. Our AI-powered automation does that work for the pharmacy team.

As an Onboarding Technician, you instruct an automation agent on how each pharmacy works. You map out each task step by step, think through every “if this happens, then do that,” build it in our workflow builder, and keep it running smoothly once it goes live. The job sits between two worlds. On one side are pharmacy technicians who know their PMS cold but do not think in terms of automation logic. On the other is an automation that will do exactly what you tell it, in exactly the order you tell it, and will stop when reality does not match what you wrote.

Your job is to turn the first into the second, prove it works, and fix it fast when it breaks.

**What You'll Do**

* Set up new pharmacies on our platform and make sure the device that runs their automation is connected and ready.
* Meet with pharmacy teams, learn how they work in their PMS, and map each task step by step, including the decisions and exceptions along the way.
* Build, test, and update automated workflows in our workflow builder for each PMS we support.
* Work with our engineers on the technical pieces, like how the automation recognizes PMS screens and fields, and confirm everything works in the pharmacy.
* Check automation runs every day, figure out why something stopped or failed, and fix it.
* Update workflows when a PMS releases a new version.
* Help grow a library of proven workflow templates so each new pharmacy goes live faster.
* Escalate issues you cannot solve, with screenshots, the step that failed, and what you have already tried.

**What You Bring**

* Pharmacy experience using a pharmacy management system (PMS).
* Logical, critical thinking. You can break a process into steps, think through every “if this, then that,” and figure out why something works nine times out of 10 but fails on the tenth.
* The ability to interview pharmacy staff about how they work: ask follow-up questions, catch the steps they skip because they are second nature, and confirm what you heard.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write instructions others can follow and can calmly explain an issue to a pharmacy.

**Other Details**

* Business hours across U.S. time zones, with occasional after-hours work for go-lives, PMS updates, and a shared on-call rotation as we grow.
* Occasional travel to pharmacies to set up devices and see workflows firsthand.
* You will be trained on our tools and workflows, and your skills in automation and AI will grow with the product.

**Compensation**

The approximate range for this role is $70,000 to $75,000.

### **Benefits**

Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

### **Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry**

Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace.
